name: Liveblocks OG social card by liveblocks.io
description: A 1200×630 social card built on a near-black canvas with a faint photographic grain and corner vignette, letting a single two-line white grotesque headline carry the entire composition at ~90px. The product concept is enacted rather than illustrated: two collaboration cursor chips — a magenta '✨ AI' tag and a lavender 'Stacy' name tag with cursor arrows — overlap the headline edges at opposite corners, bringing the only colour on the card. A small centred wordmark at the bottom closes the vertical axis, so hierarchy reads headline → cursor accents → brand in one glance.
